image_description: A red and white striped lionfish (Pterois) swimming over a textured, rocky reef background. The fish displays characteristic fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays and vertical dorsal spines. The image has a slightly soft, painterly quality typical of older digital photography or low-light underwater shots.
